newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPG trade very quiet, no cue from crude.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPG trade very quiet, no cue from crude.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were unchanged to a tad lower in midday Thursday trade deadened by crude oil's lack of direction and a golf tournament in Houston, players said.
The Shell golf tournament in Houston, Texas, is open to nearly all oil, product and LPG players, taking many away from their offices.
"With this golf tournament, the lack of any clear cut direction on crude and people involved with contract negotiations, this market is not going anywhere," said a Houston LPG player.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, propane remained between 34.75 cents and 35.00 cents a gallon. Conway, Kansas, traded at 35.25 cents, about a quarter to a half cent lower than Wednesday.
Conway ethane was pegged at 15.00/15.50 cents, unchanged from Wednesday. Belvieu ethane purity was also steady at 19.25/19.75 cents. - ((Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1631))
